subject.title: fix(cli): reject unknown models in config set

question: Should `openclaw config set` now fail before writing whenever a changed text-model primary or fallback cannot resolve through the prepared runtime catalog?
rationale: This is a user-visible CLI/config compatibility decision: the branch intentionally replaces a deferred agent-run failure with an immediate configuration-write failure, including when catalog resolution cannot be prepared.

options.title: Approve write-time validation
options.body: Accept immediate rejection for unresolved changed text-model references so invalid config is not persisted and later agent runs do not fail with an opaque model error.

options.title: Retain deferred behavior
options.body: Do not merge this policy change if temporary catalog unavailability must remain non-blocking for `config set`; define a narrower supported validation boundary first.

recommendation.title: Approve write-time validation
recommendation.body: Accept immediate rejection for unresolved changed text-model references so invalid config is not persisted and later agent runs do not fail with an opaque model error.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit trail shows sustained direct ownership of this validation boundary, though final compatibility policy belongs with the repository’s human review gate.
